metadata.title: Custom Software, Automation & Integrations | Marco Galván
metadata.description: I build internal systems, automate processes, and integrate tools for businesses that need to bring order to their operations and reduce manual work.

hero.title: I build software for businesses that need to bring order to processes, automate tasks, and connect their systems.
hero.description: I design internal systems, automations, and integrations around the way your operation actually works. When spreadsheets, WhatsApp, or manual work start to fall short, I can help you build a better solution.
hero.primaryCta: Tell me which process you want to improve
hero.proof: I work directly with you · A product of my own in production · Experience building real systems

problem.title: As operations grow, improvised tools start costing time.
problem.body: Spreadsheets, WhatsApp, and off-the-shelf tools can work perfectly well for a long time. The problem appears when the team begins compensating for their limits with manual work, duplicated information, and processes that are difficult to control.
items: The same information is entered more than once.
A process depends on messages and reminders.
Different people work with different information.
A simple task passes through too many hands.
Important information depends on one person.
Two necessary tools do not communicate.
problem.closing: When that happens, working more is often not the answer. Designing a better system is.

capabilities.title: What I can solve
capabilities.intro: I do not start with a technology. First I understand how the process works, then I decide what is worth building, automating, or integrating.

items.title: Process automation
items.description: I reduce repetitive work, manual entry, and steps that take time without adding value.

items.title: Internal systems
items.description: I design tools tailored to operations that no longer fit well in spreadsheets or generic software.
items.cta: Tell me what you need to organize

items.title: Integrations
items.description: I connect the tools you already use to avoid duplicated information and interrupted processes between systems.
items.cta: Show me which systems you need to connect

capabilities.iaNote: I use AI when it truly improves a process: information extraction, classification, assistance, analysis, or reducing costly tasks. If traditional automation is simpler, more reliable, and more affordable, I prefer that solution.

steps.title: Understand
steps.description: First I learn how the operation works today, who is involved, what information they use, and where friction appears.

steps.title: Define
steps.description: We prioritize the right problem and decide whether to automate, integrate existing tools, or build something new.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: I develop the solution in stages, validating important decisions before adding complexity.

steps.title: Put into production
steps.description: The solution has to work outside a demo: real data, real users, permissions, errors, and maintenance.

items.name: Marfen
items.title: A live management system for kiosks, convenience stores and small retailers.
items.description: Marfen is a management system for kiosks, convenience stores and small retailers. I designed and built it from scratch to centralize sales, inventory, cash management, purchases, suppliers, store credit and profitability. It is currently live and being used in a real retail operation while I continue iterating from direct user feedback.
items.role: Product strategy, product discovery, product design, architecture, full-stack development, and ongoing product evolution.

marfenCase.title: Turning a real commercial operation into software
body: Marfen began with a concrete need: centralizing sales, inventory, cash management, purchases, store credit, and profitability in one tool.
I designed and built the product from scratch, working from the operation's real rules and evolving it through daily use.

professionalCase.title: From a process that took days to one completed in hours
professionalCase.problem: An operational process depended on different information sources, validations, and manual steps that required coordination among several parties.
professionalCase.solution: The flow was redesigned and automations, data transformations, and validations were added to reduce manual intervention and improve traceability.
professionalCase.result: A process that took several days was completed in a matter of hours.
professionalCase.cta: Do you have a similar process?

experienceSummary.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm Marco Galván, a software developer. I build systems, automations, and integrations around real operational problems.
I'm especially interested in the work that happens before code: understanding how a business works, finding where time is lost, and deciding what is worth building.
I work directly with the person who knows the problem and can be involved from analysis through production.

fit.title: I can probably help if…
items: There is a process taking too much time.
An existing system is no longer enough.
You know the problem even if you do not yet know the solution.
fit.note: If you are only looking for programming hours at the lowest possible cost, I am probably not the best fit.
